F='41467_2021_22676_MOESM9_ESM.xlsx/Drug responses of LCOs/'
def trip(col,row): return [F+c+str(row) for c in col]
S=lambda refs: {"refs":refs,"aggregate":"mean","threshold":0.5,"op":"<"}
recs=[
 ("LC96+PC",   S(trip(['B','C','D'],58)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I3","map":{"PD to PC":0}}),
 ("LC132+Afa", S(trip(['B','C','D'],33)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I4","map":{"PD to Afa":0}}),
 ("CRC1+Oxa",  S(trip(['B','C','D'],153)), {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/E5","map":{"PD":0}}),
 ("LC131+Gef", S(trip(['B','C','D'],11)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I6","map":{"non-PD":1}}),
 ("LC133+Gef", S(trip(['W','X','Y'],11)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I7","map":{"PR to Gef":1}}),
 ("LC134+GC",  S(trip(['E','F','G'],82)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I8","map":{"PR to GC":1}}),
 ("LC101+Gef", S(trip(['H','I','J'],11)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I9","map":{"non-PD to Osi":1}}),
 ("LC127+PC",  S(trip(['Q','R','S'],58)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I10","map":{"PD":0}}),
 ("LC97+GC",   S(trip(['B','C','D'],82)),  {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I14","map":{"PD to GC":0}}),
 ("LC137+EC",  {"ref":"vision/LC137_EC_onchip_resistant"}, {"ref":"supp.xlsx/Sheet1/E22","map":{"PD":0}}),
]
records=[{"id":i,"score":s,"truth":t} for i,s,t in recs]
# verify with resolved means
means={"LC96+PC":0.6150,"LC132+Afa":0.6249,"CRC1+Oxa":0.6672,"LC131+Gef":0.0447,"LC133+Gef":0.2411,
       "LC134+GC":0.2630,"LC101+Gef":0.2043,"LC127+PC":1.0097,"LC97+GC":1.0806,"LC137+EC":0.0}
truths={"LC96+PC":0,"LC132+Afa":0,"CRC1+Oxa":0,"LC131+Gef":1,"LC133+Gef":1,"LC134+GC":1,"LC101+Gef":1,"LC127+PC":0,"LC97+GC":0,"LC137+EC":0}
acc=sum(1 for k in means if (means[k]<0.5)==(truths[k]==1))/10
print("computed accuracy:",acc)

unit.explanation: One record per patient organoid line paired with the specific regimen the patient received and that was tested on-chip

platform.explanation: 1-week drug sensitivity tests run on the InSMAR superhydrophobic microwell array chip

readout.explanation: On-chip calls derive from fitted dose-response curves (IC50 / AUC-DRC; Supp Fig 11a heat map of log10(IC50)); reconstructed here from viability at the top drug concentration

direction.explanation: Lower IC50 / lower residual viability indicates sensitivity

threshold_rule.explanation: Published comparison is categorical on-chip sensitive/non-sensitive vs patient responder/non-responder (Supp Fig 11d); no numeric cutoff published

patient_mapping.explanation: Grey rows of Supplementary Data 2 give each evaluable patient ID, regimen and response evaluation

regimen_match.explanation: 9/10 exact regimen matches; LC101 compared on-chip gefitinib with clinical osimertinib (same EGFR-TKI class)

n_units.explanation: Ten organoid lines with evaluable and comparable patient responses

split.explanation: No discovery/training cohort; the 10 pairs are the entire comparison

notes: article:p27: 1-week on-chip results agreed with clinical data in 10/10 evaluable lines = 100% accuracy and specificity (Fisher P=0.0048); Supp Fig 11d contingency 4/0/0/6 confirms (4+6)/10.

Score = mean replicate viability at the highest tested concentration (Source Data 'Drug responses of LCOs'); <0.5 = on-chip sensitive. LC137+EC on-chip call taken from Supp Fig 11a heat map (red, resistant) as no numeric EC curve is provided.
Truth = patient response from Supplementary Data 2 grey rows: responder (PR/CR/non-PD)=1, non-responder (PD)=0; CRC1 and LC137 truth from response to the previous regimen with the same agent class.
